description: Check a running zauth repo scan by sessionToken (returned by xpay_zauth_reposcan). FREE, read-only, no wallet - always use this to follow up on a pending scan instead of re-calling xpay_zauth_reposcan, which would pay again. Pass the sessionToken (the long JWT starting with "eyJ"), NOT the scanId - the scanId is rejected with a 401.

sessionToken.description: sessionToken from a pending xpay_zauth_reposcan result - the long JWT string (starts with "eyJ"), not the scanId. Valid ~1 hour after the scan started.

name: xpay_zauth_scan_status
